harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Added a persistent 520 MiB disk-backed swap file on node1. It provides 545,255,424 usable bytes at priority 100, preferred over the existing swap partition at priority -2. A full reboot confirmed automatic activation. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0, SSH, and enforcing SELinux were preserved. The pre-existing ip_set driver warning remains non-fatal.
actions_performed: Created fully allocated /swapfile with mode 0600 and the SELinux swapfile_t label.
Added `/swapfile none swap defaults,pri=100 0 0` to /etc/fstab and validated it with zero errors.
Preserved the original fstab as root-only /etc/fstab.pre-swapfile.bak.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Completed post-restart health, persistence, access, security, listener, and residue checks.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap is active and preferred over existing swap
evidence.summary: Shows a fully allocated, contiguous 545,259,520-byte file providing 545,255,424 usable bytes at priority 100; existing /dev/vda3 remains at priority -2.

evidence.requirement: Swap is active automatically at boot
evidence.summary: Shows the validated fstab entry and systemd-generated swap unit, followed by automatic active state after reboot with SourcePath=/etc/fstab.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID 22045032-4379-47d6-bbf6-319fdca89750, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 8593db41-7790-4429-8af4-1bcf7beec2dc, and recovered swap/services/security state.

evidence.requirement: Operating system, kernel, access, and security controls preserved
evidence.summary: Confirms the same RHEL release and kernel, unchanged SSH configuration checksum, active SSH, unchanged listeners, enforcing SELinux, system state running, and zero failed units.
